info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Policies Retrieval API
info.description: The Corporate Policies Retrieval API allows businesses to access and review existing corporate policies within the banking sector. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and corporate compliance teams to efficiently retrieve comprehensive policy information. Typical consumers include compliance officers and risk management professionals who require up-to-date policy documentation for auditing and adherence purposes. By using this API, organizations can ensure they are aligned with current regulations and internal standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current corporate policies, providing essential guidelines and standards for the organization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve corporate policies related to business direction. It includes the necessary parameters to fetch the desired policies based on the specified criteria.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the corporate policies data.

GetCorporatePoliciesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving corporate policies related to operations in the business direction.

items.description: A list of initiatives associated with the corporate policies.

sort.description: Sorting criteria applied to the items.

GetCorporatePoliciesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET request to corporate policies operations. Contains a list of initiatives, pagination details, sorting information, and metadata.

initiativeId.description: The unique identifier for the initiative.

sponsorId.description: The unique identifier for the sponsor of the initiative.

planningHorizon.description: The planning horizon for the initiative.

targetDate.description: The target date for the initiative.

status.description: The current status of the initiative.

recordStatus.description: The record status of the initiative.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp for when the initiative was last updated.

Initiative.description: An initiative object containing detailed information about a specific initiative.

page.description: The current page number of the paginated response.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page in the paginated response.

totalItems.description: The total number of items available across all pages.

Pagination.description: Pagination information for the list of items in the response.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID for tracking requests.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp for when the response was generated.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication scheme, which requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be sent in the Authorization header of each request. The JWT should be obtained via a secure authentication process and must be valid to access protected resources.
